name: multi-date-picker
title: Multi date picker
description: Pick several separate days on one calendar: click to add, Shift-click for a run, a chip list underneath and a limit if you want one.
docs: value is a list of ISO dates ("2026-10-27") in any order; onValueChange reports them in date order, each once. A click adds a day or takes it away, and Shift-click adds every day between the last pick and this one (days that cannot be picked are left out). The keyboard works as in the house Calendar: arrows move by day and week, Page Up and Down by month (Shift for a year), Home and End to the ends of the week, Enter or Space picks, and Shift with them adds a run. min and max bound the days that can be picked, disabledDates takes a list or a function for holidays and sold-out days, and a day that is out of reach is struck through inside its month. maxDates sets a limit: once it is reached the days that are not picked turn off and carry the reason (aria-describedby points at it), and a run that does not fit is cut short from the last pick outwards, with a line that says how many days were added. The chosen days are listed as removable chips with the weekday ("Tue 27 Oct", with the year added when the picks span years); Backspace or Delete on a chip's remove button hands the focus to the chip beside it. One polite line counts the picks ("3 dates selected, up to 5"), and Clear removes everything in one step. locale names the weekdays and months, weekStartsOn sets the first column, timeZone only decides which day is today, defaultMonth sets where an empty picker opens, and labels replaces every sentence. name sends one hidden input per day.
